project.name: Al Hasad News Agency
project.objective: Build a complete, high-end Arabic news website with full RTL support, responsive mobile design, homepage, section pages, article pages, and admin panel for managing articles, categories, and images.
project.scope: Homepage, 5 section pages (Local/International News, Sports, Women & Society, Accidents), article pages, admin panel with CRUD for articles/categories/images, search, responsive RTL design
functionalRequirements: FR-002: Homepage with breaking news, featured hero, latest grid
FR-006: Article CRUD with rich text, images, categories

architecture.overview: Full-stack Next.js 15 with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4. SSR for news pages, SPA admin panel. SQLite for dev, Cloudflare D1 for prod.
architecture.stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Drizzle ORM, better-sqlite3/D1, TipTap, JWT auth
architecture.dataModel: Articles, Categories, Images, Admin Users tables

designDirection.visualStyle: High-end editorial — clean typography, strong hierarchy, sophisticated palette, generous spacing

assumptions: Arabic primary language, no bilingual v1
Trusted staff, no role tiers v1
successCriteria: SC-001: All 5 section pages render RTL at both breakpoints
SC-002: Admin full CRUD without technical knowledge
SC-003: Homepage loads within performance budget
SC-004: Article pages display correctly in RTL
SC-005: Mobile responsive, no horizontal scroll, tap targets ≥44px
